title: Deterministic rule-based matcher (first-stage router)
question_or_target: Implement the deterministic first stage: a trigger table matching on literal keyword, glob path, cwd prefix, and tool-verb, with NO model call. Every selection this stage makes must be explainable by naming the exact table row that fired, and the stage must be able to return the empty set.
answer: tools/router/rule_matcher.py matches four disjoint trigger kinds against structured role fields only. Selections cite fired row_id values. Eight labelled no-fit queries and a bare query return the empty set. Deleting kw.pytest turns exactly one labelled query red (['q-kw.pytest']). No model call. No default row.
use_vs_mention: Matcher reads keyword/path/cwd/tool_verb roles. Payload text that names sibling patterns does not fire those rows. Eight no-fit queries mention table patterns in payload and still return [].

dependencies_inputs.command-center/receipts/IMP-0388.json: absent-in-this-worktree; matcher does not require the linter report at runtime

reviewer.verified: empty-set path reachable; not swallowed by a default
